claims.claim: Banks must open an SME account within three business days of a complete application.
Any delay beyond fourteen days requires a written reason given to the applicant.
No closure fee may be charged on an account held longer than six months.
Banks may not require the purchase of an unrelated product as a condition of opening an account.
The three-day period begins when the application file is complete, not when it is submitted.
The opening deadline does not apply where enhanced financial-crime due diligence is required.
